title: Granada
subtitle: The Last Kingdom of al-Andalus
simulation_note: This is a game, not a history. The valley, its steward, its crops, prices and seasons are invented for play. The places named are real, and what the museum knows of them is one link away.
days_left: {n} days to the end of winter
q01-water_text: Bring water to the olive terrace for three days, through a branch that can carry it.
q02-harvest_text: Bring in the wheat of the mill field, or sell it: nine parts in ten at least.
q03-reserve_text: As winter approaches, hold twenty days of food for ten days running.
q04-home_text: Build a house, and see a new household arrive.
q05-granary_text: When the store is full, make room in it again.
goal_text: All five done, welfare at {welfare} or more, no household lost, and {days} days of food in store.
advice_harvest: The {field} stands ripe. It begins to spoil in {days} days.
advice_spoiling: The crop of the {field} is spoiling where it stands.
advice_store_full: The store is full: part of the {field} waits in the field.
advice_thirsty: The households were short of water yesterday.
advice_branch: The {field} gets less water than it needs: its branch is broken.
advice_sow: The {field} lies fallow and could be sown now.
advice_house: Every house is full, and people would come if there were room.
field_account: Brought in {brought}, sold from the field {sold}, spoiled {spoiled}
branch_flowing: Its branch carries {carries} a day; the crop wants {wants}.
branch_weak: Its branch is broken: it carries {carries} a day of the {wants} the crop wants.
act_harvest_wait: Bring it in; what does not fit waits in the field
act_harvest_sell: Bring it in; sell from the field what does not fit
work_repair_text: The olive terrace gets the water it needs.
work_expand_text: The terrace at full flow, and water to the river meadow.
work_granary_text: Room for 500 more in the store.
refuse_already-under-way: Work on the channel is already under way.
refuse_wrong-season: It is not the season for it.
refuse_not-enough: You do not have that many.
refuse_market-out: The market does not have that many.
refuse_market-poor: The market cannot pay for that many.
market_note: You buy at the higher price and are paid the lower. The market has only so much to sell, and only so much money.
sky_note: This is the weather that will come, not a guess.
ledger_none: Nothing has happened yet. Let a day pass.
event_store-full: The store is full; part of the {field} waits in the field.
event_built_expand: The channel is rebuilt. Water reaches the river meadow.
event_hungry: The households were {n} short of food.
event_thirsty: The households were {n} short of water.
event_arrived: Two households have come to the valley.
event_left: Two households have left the valley.
brief_text: Late spring. You are the steward of a valley district: sixty households, a store nearly full, and ninety-six days until the end of winter. The wheat of the mill field stands ripe. The olive terrace is thirsty behind a broken branch. The river meadow has never been watered.
outcome_won: The valley is fed, housed and watered.
outcome_lost: The winter ends with work undone.
reason_reserve: Less than {n} days of food in store
help_text: Let the days pass, or step them one at a time. Choose a tab to see the fields, the works and the market, and order what you decide. The top bar shows the valley now; the line under it shows what tomorrow and the next ten days will bring if you do nothing more. Every figure can be reached with the keyboard.
save_failed: This device would not save the game.
save_unreadable: The saved game could not be read and was set aside.
save_newer: The saved game is from a newer version of the game.
